mainEntity.name: How much does a Land Rover Defender 90 P425 engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full reconditioned or rebuilt Land Rover Defender 90 P425 engine typically costs between £5,500 and £12,000 for the unit itself, depending on the level of rebuild.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of supercharger or cooling failure in a Land Rover Defender 90 P425?

acceptedAnswer.text: Early detection is critical to preventing catastrophic damage to your AJ133 V8 engine. Listen for a distinct rattling or whining noise from the supercharger on deceleration. Look for unexplained coolant loss, sweet smells from the engine bay, or overheating warnings on the dashboard.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Land Rover Defender 90 P425?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, absolutely, given the high retained values of the L663 V8 Defender range. A rebuilt AJ133 engine with upgraded supercharger couplers and cooling components can extend the vehicle's life significantly. For vehicles valued over £80,000, a warranted reconditioned engine protects your investment far better than a cheap used unit.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between the P425 and P525 Defender 90 engines?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both variants use the same legendary 5.0-litre supercharged V8 hardware. The P425 is intentionally detuned via a revised ECU map to produce 425 PS, offering a smoother, more refined daily driving experience. The P525 produces 525 PS, prioritising maximum peak performance.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Land Rover Defender 90 P425 engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A straightforward supply and fit of a reconditioned AJ133 engine typically takes 3 to 5 days at a specialist workshop. This allows time for proper bedding-in procedures, ECU calibration, fluid checks, and a thorough road test to ensure the V8 powertrain is balanced and performing correctly.

problems.h4: Supercharger Coupler Wear & Coolant Leaks - Why the Land Rover Defender 90 P425 AJ133 Requires Attention
problems.rootCause: The supercharger coupler can degrade over time, causing a rattling noise on deceleration, while plastic coolant crossover pipes are prone to becoming brittle and leaking under thermal stress.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace supercharger coupler, inspect and replace coolant crossover pipes and seals.
repairOptions.longevity: Highly recommended as preventative maintenance to avoid catastrophic overheating or supercharger failure.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: The right call if there is bottom-end wear, severe overheating damage, or you want long-term reliability for a high-value keeper vehicle.

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical Land Rover Defender 90 P425 in running condition is valued between £80,000 and £110,000+ depending on specification and mileage [THIRD-PARTY]. - Vehicle worth under ~£5,000: repair or used engine typically makes more sense than a full rebuilt unit. - Vehicle worth ~£5,000-£8,000: evaluate both; reconditioned is viable if keeping the car 2+ years. - Vehicle worth ~£8,000-£15,000: reconditioned/rebuilt usually justifies the premium via warranty and reliability. - Vehicle worth £15,000+: replacement cost is typically small relative to vehicle value. Note: For a high-value asset like the Defender 90 P425, investing in a fully rebuilt AJ133 engine with upgraded components is highly recommended to protect the vehicle's substantial market value.
problems.recommendation: If your Defender 90 P425 is exhibiting early signs of supercharger rattle or minor coolant seepage, a preventative specialist service is a cost-effective solution. However, if the engine has suffered severe overheating or internal damage, a full reconditioned replacement is the most reliable long-term investment to preserve the vehicle's performance and value.
